full_name: Jaimie Baron | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2022–2023 Humanities Mildred Londa Weisman Fellow University of Alberta (Canada)
bio: Jaimie Baron is a professor of film studies whose work on documentary, experimental film and video, audiovisual appropriation, and digital media has been published in numerous journals and anthologies.
